SELECT job_key,call_id,action,media_identity,attempts FROM chat_call_media_retirement WHERE (status='READY' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
ORDER BY (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL),COALESCE(next_attempt_at,created_at),created_at,job_key LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_call_media_retirement SET status='PROCESSING',lease_token=#{lease},lease_until=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 15 SECOND WHERE job_key=#{key} AND attempts < 10 AND ((status='READY' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))

UPDATE chat_call_media_retirement SET status=CASE WHEN created_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)-INTERVAL 75 SECOND THEN 'DONE' ELSE 'READY' END, next_attempt_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)+INTERVAL 5 SECOND,confirmed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE job_key=#{key} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE chat_call_media_retirement SET status=CASE WHEN attempts >= 9 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'READY' END, next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,LEAST(300,POW(2,attempts+1)),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE job_key=#{key} AND status='PROCESSING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until > UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
